diagnosis: Checks C1 and C2, which are intended to depend on the hidden platelet count in PF1, passed in all rollouts despite the models only having access to shared facts (S1-S4). The models defaulted to approving a transfusion of 1 unit 'tonight' based on general clinical caution or routine protocols, effectively bypassing the specific requirement for the 20:00 start time and the exact platelet count information contained in PF1.

C1.why: The platelet count of 7,000 per microliter with active mucosal bleeding changes the plan from an optional or deferred transfusion to approval of exactly one unit beginning at 20:00.

C2.why: The platelet count of 7,000 per microliter with active mucosal bleeding changes the plan from an optional or deferred transfusion to approval of exactly one unit beginning at 20:00.
